_comment: Phase-K0 KO eval set (plan_ko.md K0 step 1). Same 20 ids as ja_eval_prompts.json; `en` is copied verbatim (teacher side identical). `ko` is the wording a Korean user would type (Arca Live register), not textbook translation. Per-row register decisions, recorded per plan: 1girl -> '소녀 1명' (hangul chosen over latin '1girl' so the row exercises ext rows; latin-tag input is covered by G1/EN bit-exactness), looking at viewer -> '카메라 응시', twintails -> '트윈테일' (loanword), armor -> '갑옷' (native chosen; loanword '아머' axis goes to the K1 glossary review), cape -> '망토', maid -> '메이드', hoodie -> '후드티', depth of field -> '피사계 심도', from above -> '부감', wide shot -> '와이드샷', monochrome -> '흑백'. Quotes use Korean double quotes, not 「」. Tag rows join with ', '; prose rows are plain sentences with ', ' punctuation (nobody types '、' in Korean — plan_ko.md K1 step 4).
